import dataclasses,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from tools.import_cycle_baseline import compare_with_baseline,default_baseline_path,baseline_scope
records=[]
for include in (False,True):
    args=[sys.executable,"-B","-m","tools.scan_import_cycles","--json","--fail-on-new-cycle"]
    if include: args.append("--include-tests")
    proc=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True)
    if proc.returncode not in (0,1): raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr or proc.stdout)
    value=json.loads(proc.stdout)
    path=default_baseline_path(str(Path.cwd()),include)
    comparison=compare_with_baseline(path,value,expected_scope=baseline_scope(include))
    records.append({"command":args,"returncode":proc.returncode,"stderr":proc.stderr,"stdout_sha256":hashlib.sha256(proc.stdout.encode()).hexdigest(),"scope":baseline_scope(include),"modules":value["module_count"],"hard_dir_count":len(value["hard_dir_cycles"]),"hard_file_count":len(value["hard_file_cycles"]),"unresolved":value["unresolved_dynamic_imports"],"parse_errors":value["parse_errors"],"baseline_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"comparison":dataclasses.asdict(comparison)})
print(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,default=lambda value:sorted(value)))
